# Thomas Van Den Driessche

> Thomas Van Den Driessche is a Belgian documentary photographer based in Waterloo, near Brussels. His long-form stories look at contemporary India and its rapid industrialisation, at Belgium's rituals and post-industrial towns, and at Eastern Europe's unrecognised states. He also makes portraits and editorial commissions for Le Monde, Monocle, Libération and The New York Times.

Contact: thomasvdd79@gmail.com, +32 478 24 00 51, Waterloo, Belgium. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thomasvdd/

## Personal Works (https://www.phototvdd.be/personal-works/)
- [Open Head & Fragmented Memories](https://www.phototvdd.be/open-head/): Building Solvay, Brussels, Belgium, 2015–2016. Inside Denis Meyers' monumental typographic fresco covering the abandoned Solvay building in Brussels before its demolition.
- [Transnistria, De Facto](https://www.phototvdd.be/transnistria-de-facto-1/): Transnistria, 2015. Transnistria, the self-proclaimed republic between the Dniester and Ukraine, celebrates 25 years of an independence no country recognises.
- [Links to the Motherland](https://www.phototvdd.be/links-to-the-motherland/): Transnistria, 2015. Roadside shrines in Transnistria, where Soviet symbols and Orthodox Christianity stand side by side.
- [Porcelain Wedding Anniversary](https://www.phototvdd.be/porcelain-wedding-anniversary/): Vietnam, 2014. Twenty years after the end of the US trade embargo, Vietnam's market economy and the new middle class it created.
- [Juhu Beach Photographers](https://www.phototvdd.be/juhu-beach-photographers/): Mumbai, India, 2014. The instant-print photographers of Juhu Beach in Mumbai, keeping India's culture of printed pictures alive.
- [Bangers Rules](https://www.phototvdd.be/bangers-rules/): Belgium, France, 2012–2013. Banger racing in Belgium and France: old cars, crowds and crashes on weekend dirt tracks.
- [The Magic Slum](https://www.phototvdd.be/the-magic-slum/): Delhi, India, 2012. The Bhatt family of Rajasthani puppeteers and street performers in Kathputli Colony, Delhi's 'magic slum', before its demolition.
- [Jharia, the Burning City](https://www.phototvdd.be/jharia-the-burning-city/): Jharia, India, 2009–2012. Life above underground coal fires in Jharia, India's largest mining area, where 400,000 people live on burning ground.
- [IT City, the Turning Point](https://www.phototvdd.be/it-city-the-turning-point-1/): Bangalore, India, 2014. Bangalore at a turning point, from India's 'Garden City' to a global IT hub racing to build new infrastructure.
- [Welcome to Tata City](https://www.phototvdd.be/welcome-to-tata-city/): Jamshedpur, India, 2009. Jamshedpur, the Indian company town where cars, tea, schools and stadiums all carry the Tata name.

## Diaries (https://www.phototvdd.be/diaries/)
- [How to Be a Photographer](https://www.phototvdd.be/how-to-be-a-photographer/): Brussels, Belgium, 2012–2013. A tongue-in-cheek photo-booth manual in four-frame strips, published as a book by André Frère Éditions and collected by the Centre Pompidou.
- [The Shift, Part I](https://www.phototvdd.be/the-shift-part-i/): . A handmade photographic notebook of portraits, contact prints and typewritten notes.
- [The Shift, Part II](https://www.phototvdd.be/the-shift-part-ii/): . The second handmade notebook of The Shift: black-and-white prints, contact sheets and typewritten diary entries.
- [Indian Diary 2012](https://www.phototvdd.be/indian-diary-2012/): . A handwritten travel diary from India in 2012, with instant prints, tickets and notes.

## Commissioned Works (https://www.phototvdd.be/commissioned-works/)
- [I Paid a Bribe](https://www.phototvdd.be/i-paid-a-bribe/): Bangalore, India, 2014. How Indian citizens fight everyday corruption with the website I Paid a Bribe, in Bangalore. Wave project, BNP Paribas and Festival Circulation(s).
- [The Heart Temple](https://www.phototvdd.be/the-heart-temple/): Bangalore, India, 2014. Dr Devi Prasad Shetty's hospital in Bangalore, which aims to make heart surgery affordable for India's poor. Wave project, BNP Paribas and Festival Circulation(s).
- [E-School Nalanda](https://www.phototvdd.be/eschool-nalanda/): Mumbai, India, 2014. Low-cost digital classrooms for children from modest families in Mumbai and Pune primary schools. Wave project, BNP Paribas and Festival Circulation(s).
- [First Visit in Ukraine](https://www.phototvdd.be/first-visit-in-ukraine/): Belgium – Ukraine, November 2015. Travelling with NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg on his first official visit to Kiev, for Monocle.
- [Molenbeek, Artists Haunt](https://www.phototvdd.be/molenbeek-repaire-dartistes/): Brussels, Belgium, April 2016. Molenbeek in Brussels as a home for artists of every nationality, for M, le magazine du Monde.

## Archives (https://www.phototvdd.be/archives/)
- [Marcheurs](https://www.phototvdd.be/marcheurs/): Belgium, 2011–2012. The military folk marches of Entre-Sambre-et-Meuse, Belgium, where villages parade their saints' relics in historical uniforms.
- [Turfing in Calcutta](https://www.phototvdd.be/turfing-in-calcutta/): Calcutta, India, 2012. The Royal Calcutta Turf Club, founded in 1847 and the oldest racecourse in the Indian subcontinent.
- [Ultimate](https://www.phototvdd.be/ultimate/): . Behind the scenes of a fight night: fighters, ring, crowd and organisers.
- [Wargame](https://www.phototvdd.be/wargame/): Belgium, 2009–2011. A weekend paintball war game in the Belgian Ardennes, where more than a hundred players from across Europe stage combat.
- [Daily Life at the Akhara](https://www.phototvdd.be/daily-life-at-the-akhara/): . Daily life in an akhara, a traditional Indian wrestling school, where young men train in the earth pit.
- [Immaculées Conceptions](https://www.phototvdd.be/immaculees-conceptions/): Belgium, 2011–2012. The thousands of Lourdes grottoes built across Belgium after the Marian apparitions of the 1930s.
